LESSON: ATHLETICS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: PERFORMING AND DISPLAYING Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Athletics
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Athletics, part of PERFORMING AND DISPLAYING Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: Why is appropriate posture important in sprinting? 2. Why is the Kenya National Anthem performed during an athletic event?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Athletics together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: Exploration: A learner develops exploration skills while they generate ideas on how to draw,

paint and manipulate the Kenyan flag.

• Digital literacy: Interacting with digital technology: A learner develops skills of interacting with digital technology while

searching for information on sprints and the Kenyan flag from online sources.

24

Values:
• Peace: Compassion: Learners demonstrate compassion skills while performing cool-down activities in groups.

• Patriotism: Devotion: Learners develop devotion skills while drawing, painting and manipulating the East African

community flag.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Safety and security: Learners develop personal safety skills while performing a sprint competition ensuring safety.

• Social cohesion: Learners develop social cohesion skills as they perform cool down activities in groups.

Link to other subjects:

Social studies- Learners identify colours of the Kenyan flag covered in Social Studies.

Suggested Assessment Resources:

Audio-visual recordings, digital devices with assistive technology such as screen readers, East African Community Anthem in

print and braille, Kenyan flag, stick flag
